# Numerimondes

> Company website for Numerimondes SARL AU, based in Casablanca, Morocco. It describes the company's services, capabilities, projects, and published policies. Service availability, scope, pricing, and commitments are confirmed for each engagement.

## Start here

- [Home](/) — company and service overview.
- [Services Marketplace](/services/marketplace) — illustrative service catalogue; not a binding offer or price list.
- [Capabilities](/capabilities/) — areas of expertise and exploration.
- [Company](/company/about-us/numerimondes) — company background and delivery approach.

## Policies

- [Policies](/policies/) — collection index.
- [Pricing and Engagements](/policies/pricing) — pricing approach and published starting price.
- [Website Development Policy](/policies/website-development-policy) — website project minimum and scope boundaries.
- [Client engagement policy](/policies/client-engagement) — proposed engagement boundaries; draft.
- [Client data handling policy](/policies/data-handling) — proposed data handling boundaries; draft.
- [Security and incident reporting policy](/policies/security-reporting) — proposed reporting guidance; draft.
- [Availability and support policy](/policies/service-support) — proposed service commitments; draft.
- [Partner and contractor policy](/policies/partner-terms) — proposed collaboration terms; draft.
- [Automated access and content use policy](/policies/automated-access) — proposed website terms; draft and not yet operative.

## Legal and contact

- [Website Terms of Use](/legal/website-terms-of-use) — rules for accessing and using the public website.
- [Website Development Terms and Conditions](/legal/website-development-terms-and-conditions) — terms for a separately agreed website development project.
- [Website privacy notice](/legal/site-privacy) — describes the website's current privacy notice.
- [Contact](/company/contact) — contact options.
- [Robots instructions](/robots.txt) — published crawler preferences. This file does not authorize crawling or grant rights to reuse content.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml) — generated page index.

## Access and use

Follow the published [robots.txt](/robots.txt) crawler preferences. Do not treat this discovery file as permission to scrape, bulk-extract, train on, or reuse site content. The automated-access policy is still a draft; it does not replace the crawler preferences or establish an operative contract term.
